legacy.role: solved_date, solver labels, found_pct provenance, #135 solve tx/block/url

candidate.role: compressed pubkeys, English notes, sparse source_label

cryptographicCheck.note: Local cryptographic consistency of catalog material. Not a chain census and not a live-balance check.

chainFreshness.note: No live balance or latest-chain verification is stored or claimed.

conventions.search_bits: bits - 1. Search interval width in bits. Inclusive range [2^(bits-1), 2^bits - 1], size 2^(bits-1).
conventions.found_pct: Legacy snapshot display string. Provenance only. Not recomputed.
conventions.found_offset_pct: (k - 2^(n-1)) / 2^(n-1) * 100. Puzzle #1 is a singleton so the offset is 0. Legacy found_pct for #1 is 100%.
conventions.reward_btc: Nominal catalog allocation n * 0.1 BTC. Not a live UTXO balance.
conventions.status: solved | unsolved. A catalog spend record, not a live UTXO check.
conventions.search_class: historical (solved) | address-only (unsolved, no catalog pubkey) | public-key (unsolved with catalog pubkey).
conventions.historical_scalar: Source catalog only: the already-public historical solved scalar, or null. Never exported in the /data/ files. Unsafe for wallets. No WIF.
conventions.pubkey_known: True iff public_key is present. A public key is not solved status.
conventions.solver: Dated snapshot / self-attribution / community label. Not an audited identity. Early address-prefix tags (e.g. #1) and any removed address-fragment tag are legacy display strings, never identities.
conventions.source_label: Per-record evidence class where present (On-chain, Community report, Self-attribution, Cryptographically verified). Null means legacy snapshot provenance: spend asserted by the catalog file, not verified per record here.

keyMaterialWarning: Historical solved scalars in this catalog are already public reference material. They are unsafe for wallets. This catalog does not convert them to WIF.
evidenceNote: Catalog source-snapshot dates (legacy 2026-08-22; candidate 2026-08-27) are distinct from the 2026-10-02 offline cryptographic re-check and from chain freshness. Chain freshness was not performed: no stored live-balance census. A 2026-10-02 remaining-sats probe of the 77 catalog-unsolved addresses (scripts/chain-watch.cjs) found none below half its nominal reward. On 2026-10-02 the first reward spend of every solved record was read from mempool.space and cross-checked on blockstream.info (txid, block, time); all 83 solved records now store solve_txid, solve_block and solved_at (method and per-record findings: docs/atlas-work/gaps-2026-10/). Records whose only evidence is that spend carry the On-chain label: it attests that the reward moved, not who moved it. Solver labels without a source_url remain legacy snapshot labels, not identities. solved_date keeps the catalog value; where the spend block is dated one day apart (#29, #59, #64) the record note says so. #120, #125 and #130 are Community report: their attribution to RetiredCoder rests on community records; on 2026-10-02 no primary self-attribution was found and their spend transactions carry no message. Nominal reward is not balance: 75 of 83 solved records moved less than the nominal amount. Public-key availability is not solved status.

secondaryCrossReference.role: Secondary catalog-wide comparison for the 160 puzzle records
secondaryCrossReference.limitations: Not the puzzle creator's primary source, not per-record proof of attribution, not a live-chain census, and not evidence that any unresolved record is authorized for native execution.

sourceScopeConvention.source_url: Record-specific reference. A transaction explorer link supports the recorded spend only; it does not establish solver identity.
sourceScopeConvention.dataset_source_url: Secondary dataset-wide cross-reference only. It must not satisfy the app's per-record source gate.
sourceScopeConvention.chain_tx_url: Explorer link for the stored solve_txid.
sourceScopeConvention.chain_tx_url_secondary: Independent explorer mirror for the same solve_txid.
sourceScopeConvention.source_scope: Required gate: record only when source_url is a record-specific HTTPS reference with a non-empty evidence label; missing otherwise. Dataset-wide links never count.
sourceScopeConvention.dataset_record_url: Secondary per-puzzle atlas page for traceability only. It is not primary-source proof and cannot satisfy source_scope=record.
